short_description: A bold first-words board book for ages 0–3: 14 everyday words, big friendly pictures, and a simple Grown-up corner tip on every page.
long_description:
Up! Go! More! is a sturdy first-words board book made for laps, not screens. Each page shows one everyday word a toddler actually uses (hi, up, down, go, stop, ball, uh-oh, more, all done, shoe, bye-bye, book, hug and night-night), set in huge, rounded letters beside one big, bright picture of a child and a grown-up acting it out.

At the bottom of every page, a short Grown-up corner gives you one easy way to turn reading into a back-and-forth chat: pause and wait, add one word, use a gesture, offer a choice, sing it, or follow your child's lead. There's no script to learn and nothing to get right. Pick any idea, skip any idea.

The inside front cover explains how to read the book together in five plain steps, and the inside back cover shows where these words live in your day, from mealtime to bedtime, so the talking keeps going after the book closes.

The diverse cast of toddlers, parents and grandparents appears throughout, drawn in a clean, flat, high-contrast style that little eyes can take in at a glance. A warm, practical gift for baby showers, first birthdays and anyone who loves a toddler.

compliance_notes: No health or medical claims: the book is parent education, not a clinical service, and does not claim to treat, prevent or diagnose anything. Not presented as written by a speech-language pathologist. No trademarked program names; talk strategies are described in plain words. No real brands, logos, schools or products; the tablet on the bedtime page is a generic, neutral object. No research citations are used. Safety: the book is intended for 0–3, so the printed product must have no detachable parts and should use rounded corners and non-toxic inks. As a US children's product, confirm CPSIA requirements with the printer before sale: permanent tracking information on the product, and a Children's Product Certificate based on the correct third-party testing, or documentation of the 'ordinary book' exemption if it applies [VERIFY with the printer and CPSC guidance]. For UK/EU sales, confirm whether toy-safety rules apply to board books for under-3s [VERIFY]. The print PDF is RGB; the final file must be checked against the chosen printer's current template (for example a specialty board-book printer, or KDP, IngramSpark or Lulu if they add board books) for trim, bleed, board thickness, spine, corner radius and CMYK conversion before upload.
